scope: Third native optimization round; exact before/after and independent short-corpus numerical checks; no cross-framework speed claim
model_provenance_note: Recorded full-shard checksums come from the prior verified model acceptance. This round did not modify model files or recompute all shard hashes.
implementation: Four independent 32-lane SIMD groups compute four projection rows per 128-thread group; tail rows guarded.
Q2_0, Q2_K and IQ1_M dot products reuse block metadata while preserving lane accumulation order. F16/BF16/F32 use aligned scalar loads. Activations/state remain F32, Safe math.
GLM prefill uses up to eight tokens: grouped KDA independent projections, dense/shared projections and expert-grouped MoE. Convolution, KDA recurrence and causal DSA remain ordered by position.
Masked Qwen/GLM attention score dot products are skipped; zero-probability value reads are skipped. GLM pool rank is computed once per complete pool, including tail and tie handling.
CLI default engine budget reduced from 64 to 32 GiB after stopped high-memory-pressure probes. Explicit budget remains available.

normal_command_profile.scope: Diagnostic counters over Engine lifetime and four complete requests (one warmup plus three repeats); normal command submission, no extra GPU waits; allocation time excludes destruction and bytes/weight allocation. Not a formal speed cohort.
notes: GPU command spans are included in CPU wait time; do not sum them or interpret spans as hardware occupancy.
Timing counters cover model initialization and four requests including warmup. Request-time denominator excludes Engine load, so component shares are approximate.
Only temporary Gpu::output allocation calls are timed; deallocation and other buffer APIs are not measured separately.
No additional GPU synchronization introduced. Profiles use separate evidence-only source copies; production source has no counters.
GPU submissions, encoders and allocation counts are identical in A/B; this corroborates restoring the original Qwen host scheduling before formal cohorts.
normal_command_profile.decision: Keep the measured kernel and grouped-prefill changes; do not add a new pooled-buffer ownership/lifetime abstraction for this limited measured allocation share.

limitations: Formal speed comparisons cover two fixed short prompts only. Engine load is excluded from request time and reported separately. Each process has one complete warmup before its measured request.
OS file cache and background load not controlled. Godot processes were observed during part of the Qwen 40 GiB cohort. No cold SSD claim; file_bytes are logical pread bytes, not physical SSD bytes.
GLM prefill expert groups and scalar expert visits are different cache-counter units; do not directly compare aggregate hit ratios.

2112-token tests compare native baseline and candidate complete logits at eleven checkpoints and exercise the 2048 sparse-selection boundary. They are not independent long-context reference or QA-quality acceptance. Their elapsed times are single observations.
No new 8192-token run in this round; the older Qwen 8192-token smoke remains historical evidence.
Single active session, greedy text only. MTP, random sampling, multimodal and arbitrary chat templates remain outside this implementation.

build_provenance.correction: A shared Cargo target reused an intermediate library for the original validation exporter. That binary and its numerical runs are retained under invalid/intermediate-baseline labels, excluded from acceptance. Correct baseline and final exporters rebuilt with separate targets. Formal benchmark baseline embeds original shaders; candidate embeds final shaders; every candidate __TEXT section including machine code and shader constants is byte-identical after isolated rebuild.
